thought.text: All images built. Now let me start the services.

reasoning_content:
All built. Now start the services. Note docker-compose.dev.yml uses bind mount ./postgres/data for the db. Let me create that directory. Also the tiles config references germany.mbtiles which doesn't exist - tileserver may fail. Let's check. Also caddy tries to install its CA cert - may prompt. Let's start and see.

Let me check if /workspace/deployment/postgres/data exists.

action.command: cd /workspace/deployment && ls -la postgres/ | grep data; mkdir -p postgres/data && nohup docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d > /tmp/up.log 2>&1 & echo "started $!"; sleep 30; cat /tmp/up.log
